_help: Act 7, the hotel (one action): Clara Beaumont knows where the thieves are staying (thieves_lodging); with clara_watching (Act 2) she also overheard their plan (thieves_plan_known). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act67.py.

start.speaker: clara
start.line: You look terrible, monsieur. Everyone looks terrible. The dust gets into everything.

l_americans.speaker: clara
l_americans.line: Mr. Whitfield's people are back on the second floor. Very quiet now. No more champagne. A great many crates.

l_germans.speaker: clara
l_germans.line: The professor's men came back two nights ago, very tired, with one locked trunk that never leaves their sight.

l_italians.speaker: clara
l_italians.line: Signor Rossi, the one who never came down before dark? He has friends now. Bellini, they call him. Trucks in my courtyard.

l_none.speaker: clara
l_none.line: Your thieves are not my guests, I think. But everyone passes through a hotel sooner or later.

w_americans.speaker: clara
w_americans.line: And since you asked me to keep watch: they have bought passage on a steamer from the docks. Thursday's tide.

w_germans.speaker: clara
w_germans.line: And since you asked me to watch: first-class tickets on the night express to Alexandria. I saw the envelope.

w_italians.speaker: clara
w_italians.line: And since you asked me to watch: they wait for a police permit to take their trucks out on the coast road.
